chunks: And from his will (peace be upon him) to 'Abdullah ibn al-'Abbas at the time of his appointing him as governor over Basra.

key_terms.الْبَصْرَةِ: Basra, a major city in Iraq
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْعَبَّاسِ: 'Abdullah ibn al-'Abbas, the companion and governor

ai.seo_question: What was the context of Imam Ali's letter to Abdullah ibn al-Abbas regarding the governorship of Basra?
ai.summary: This introductory clause sets the stage for Imam Ali’s (AS) detailed administrative instructions to Abdullah ibn al-Abbas, reflecting the political turbulence of the Basra governorship during the early Caliphate. It highlights the transition of authority from the Imam to a trusted companion, emphasizing the spiritual and practical dimensions of governance in Shia political thought.
